# Privacy Policy

> Markdown version of <https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/privacidade>. v2.1 · updated on 13 November 2026. The text with normative value is the HTML page.

It describes how personal data are collected, used, stored, shared and protected, according to LGPD (Law 13.709/2018), the Civil Marco da Internet (Law 12.965/2014), GDPR (EU 2016/679), CCPA/CPRA and EU AI Act (EU 2024/1689).

## 1. Summary

Only what is necessary is collected, the data is not sold, and the data subject can review, fix or delete whatever is about it at any time.

| What? | Why? | With whom | For how long |
|---|---|---|---|
| Name, e-mail and what the person writes | Handle the request | Operators only (Section 5) | 24 months or until revocation |
| IP, browser, viewed pages | Statistics and security | Google (GA4), Microsoft (Clarity), AWS | Up to 14 months (analytics) / 6 months (logs) |

## 2. Controller

Maurício Yokoyama Issei (LGPD, art. 5o, VI) — professional portfolio, technical content, consulting proposals, email contact and interactive tools that work in the browser. Contact: mauricio@issei.com.br.

## 3. Data collected

- **Registration data:** name, email and data that the person includes in the message — an e-mail sent by the person (the site has no form).
- **Behavioral:** IP, user-agent, pages, time, clicks — cookies and logs.
- **Communication:** e-mail messages.

**Not collected:** CPF, RG, bank or payment data, biometrics, health, political opinion or any sensitive data. The site has no checkout.

## 4. Legal basis

| Purpose | LGPD | GDPR |
|---|---|---|
| Response to contact and proposals | Preliminary procedures for the contract (Art. 7, V) | Art. 6, b |
| Aggregated traffic analysis | Legitimate interest with opt-out (art. 7th, IX) | Art. 6, f |
| Tax obligation | Legal obligation (Art. 7, II) | Art. 6, c |
| Access logs | Marco Civil, art. 15 | Art. 6, c |

## 5. Sharing

Data is not sold. Contracted operators: **AWS** (host S3 and CDN CloudFront), **Google** (Analytics 4 and Tag Manager), **Microsoft** (Clarity: heat maps and session recording) and **GitHub** (public `cv.json` hosting). Public authorities, by court order or legal request.

## 6. International transfer

Operators process data in the US and other countries, based on LGPD art. 33 and CD/ANPD Resolution 19/2024: standard contractual clauses, EU-U. S. Data Privacy Framework and equivalent contractual guarantees.

## 7. Retention

| Category | Time limit |
|---|---|
| Access logs (IP + timestamp) | 6 months (Marco Civil, art. 15) |
| Email contact (no hiring) | 24 months or until revocation |
| Registration data of an active client | Contract + 5 years |
| Analytical cookies (GA4) | Up to 14 months |
| Encrypted backups | Up to 90 days after exclusion |

After the deadline, the data are anonymous or deleted (LGPD, art. 16).

## 8. Rights of the holder

Confirmation, access, correction, anonymization/blocking/elimination, portability, information on sharing, revocation of consent, objection to processing based on legitimate interest and human review of automated decisions (LGPD art. 18; GDPR art. 15-22). Free service in up to 15 days (LGPD) or 30 days (GDPR). California residents: the GPC signal is respected as opt-out.

## 9. Cookies

Four categories (necessary, analysis, marketing, customization), with consent banner and no cookie wall. Today no marketing tool is active. Nominal list in [Cookie Policy](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/cookies).

## 10. IA and automated decisions

Today the site has no LLM interface or automated decision about the data subject. If it ever does: content generated by AI is identified; personal data does not train models without explicit consent; decisions with relevant effect go through human review (LGPD, art. 20) and the data subject can ask for it from DPO.

## 11. Security

TLS (versions 1.2 and 1.3), at-rest encryption, lower privilege (IAM, MFA), OIDC in CI/CD without fixed credentials. Incidents are reported to ANPD and to data subjects according to Resolution CD/ANPD 15/2024.

## 12. Children and adolescents

The site is not directed to children under 18 and does not intentionally collect data from them (LGPD art. 14).

## 13. DPO, complaints and jurisdiction

Data Protection Officer (DPO): mauricio@issei.com.br, response in up to 15 days. Claims to ANPD (gov.br/anpd) or the data protection authority of the country of residence. Brazilian law; courts of São Paulo/SP, except for courts of the consumer's domicile (CDC, art. 101, I). Material changes reopen the banner and are signaled for 30 days.
